title: Northern Thai-Style Mozzarella Bowl
description: A twist on traditional Thai dishes, this recipe combines the creaminess of mozzarella with the bold flavors of Northern Thai cuisine.

ingredients.name: Northern-style sauce (or substitute with fish sauce and lime juice)

instructions: In a large bowl, combine shredded mozzarella cheese, Thai red curry paste, coconut milk, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Stir until well combined.
Add fresh basil leaves, chilies, and fried shallots to the bowl, and mix until they are evenly distributed.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with additional mozzarella cheese if desired.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
While the cheese is baking, cook rice or noodles according to package instructions.
To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of cooked rice or noodles in the bottom of a bowl, followed by the Northern Thai-style mozzarella mixture.
Drizzle with Northern-style sauce (or a substitute made from fish sauce and lime juice) and garnish with additional basil leaves and chilies if desired.
